recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It is a narrow completion of the original FHIR-5996 application in current build-scope source and does not require further work unless the work group later changes the allowed _summary value set.
issue_request: FHIR-5996 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking not to add a new _narrative REST parameter but instead to document _summary for read as well as search and add text (narrative-only) and data (data-only) _summary values.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in commit 074d2c031a94ff1de85a5ef50c2755f2c40b1b33, which added read-interaction _summary prose to source/http.html and added text/data/count/false rows to the main _summary section of source/search.html. The Search Control Parameters table in source/search.html had been added earlier by 32fcb82713a3958004db6576b951288ec8958c7a and remained true/false-only.
additional_context: Current source/http.html already documents _summary on read and lists true, false, text, count and data. Current source/search.html already defines the detailed semantics for true, text, data, count and false. Later published issues FHIR-18094, FHIR-9416 and FHIR-33002 refined read wording and _summary=text semantics and are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html so the built Search Control Parameters table lists text, data and count in addition to true and false for _summary. This removes a current source inconsistency that could mislead implementers reading the table instead of the detailed section.
source_changes: source/search.html: updated the _summary row in the Search Control Parameters table to list true, false, text, data and count.
